long_biography.plain_text:
Yoann Chery's Groupe Leader Insurance grew through two distribution systems: branches serving clients directly and wholesale operations supplying specialist insurance products to other brokers. He brought in Abenex as a shareholder to finance acquisitions, while remaining invested alongside the group's managers.

After playing for AS Poissy as a teenager, Chery returned to football as president of Poissy FC. In 2026, he secured a three-year partnership with AJ Auxerre, choosing the club for its youth development work. The agreement provided for scouting young players and training Poissy's coaches with their Auxerre counterparts.
long_biography.html:
Yoann Chery's Groupe Leader Insurance grew through two distribution systems: branches serving clients directly and wholesale operations supplying specialist insurance products to other brokers. In 2026, he secured a three-year partnership with AJ Auxerre, choosing the club for its youth development work. The agreement provided for scouting young players and training Poissy's coaches with their Auxerre counterparts.

uncertainties: Exact authoritative inventory was run before Forbes-first research; no existing assigned dossier was present to preserve. The source has only name and vessel context, with nationality, personal facts and social links initially blank.

The identity bridge rests on the official YC Partners founder/boat-rental group, its Bizman Production presentation and the exact Bizman/Navetta 37 offering at YachtRent, alongside independent confirmation of the insurance founder. No legal vessel ownership chain is imported. An unattributed owner-yacht website naming him was only a discovery lead and is excluded from the evidence ledger.

The same-name transport worker found in search is unrelated. The primary Generation Insurance filing's name, role and 1978 birth identify the insurance entrepreneur. People-search biographies and contact aggregators are not evidence sources.

Broad Self-made is supported by creation and ownership of the core brokerage. Family wealth, original launch financing and any formative advantage are insufficiently established for either self-made subtype. No family asset transfer is inferred.

Historical claims that he owned roughly half of Leader Insurance are not represented as current. The 2025 acquisition agreement plus subsequent completion report establish the new Ardonagh relationship. Neither corporate premiums, enterprise values nor the assets of investment funds are his personal wealth.

The current investment interests span insurance, property and services. The reviewed sources do not quantify their relative private values. Finance & Investments has bounded confidence based on the current Ardonagh interest and investment platform; no exact personal net worth is proposed.

The signed 2023 company document supplies French nationality, full birth date and birthplace. It also gives a then-current French residence, but that older address does not independently establish his main residence in September 2026. Current French business activity is not substituted for residence; private street addresses are not retained.

No middle names, secondary nationality, secondary residence or useful optional honorific/suffix were verified. Current personal participation in the 2026 football interview and insurance report supports changing mortality status from Unknown to Alive. Death details remain inapplicable and calculated ages are not proposed.

Forbes-first and profile-path searches found a paid Forbes France BrandVoice feature but no verified Forbes profile. The paid interview is not used for wealth stature or as a social profile. No independent personal Wikipedia article was found; wiki-yoannchery.com is a personal site, not Wikipedia.

The exact personal LinkedIn URL is directly linked from YC Partners and independently tagged by the official acquiring company's completion announcement. The official group also links wiki-yoannchery.com, which is proposed only as Personal Website. YC Partners is separately proposed as Company Website.

Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, Youtube and TikTok searches produced no additional identity-verified personal account. Official-site Facebook links go to company accounts, while video interviews belong to broadcasters. TikTok access was restricted. No company or broadcaster account is substituted for a personal profile.

Vimeo and Flickr checks found no attributable personal account. Trip Advisor and Zillow searches found no relevant identity-verified resource; the existence of hospitality and property companies does not justify a personal directory profile.

Insurance is the minimum useful active tag. Property and hospitality holdings are recorded without assuming that each constitutes a defining operating specialism. Private-equity fund exposure is not equivalent to running those managers or owning all their portfolio companies. No generic Family office or philanthropy tag is introduced.

His football training, past playing and new Poissy FC presidency are meaningful biography facts. The short presidential tenure does not yet establish a sustained defining sporting identity under the active Football tag's binding contract, so no football tag or club-ownership claim is proposed.

The Poissy–Auxerre agreement provides for scouting and coach training. A proposed youth boarding centre remains a plan and is excluded. The sources describe AS Poissy as his earlier playing club and Poissy FC as the club he now leads; the two names are not silently equated as a legal entity.

All adopted factual claims were checked in source bodies. The newspaper article returned an error through web open but was successfully read in full from its public HTML through an ordinary unauthenticated request. Search snippets and promotional aggregators are discovery only.
